title: tephroseris subdentata
intro: Tephroseris subdentata, commonly known as the Alpine Saw-wort, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family. The Alpine Saw-wort is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe and calm the skin and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Tephroseris subdentata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic effects and the specific health benefits it may offer.
